lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: He thought I was a forgery. Somebody wearing a dead founder's face to get into rooms.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: I have spent thirty-three subjective days being told what I become. That is the first time anyone has told me I am a fake, and it was the only one that landed.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You are not a fake. You are the original, and that is the part that has to be worth something.
